XPT.reason: XPT is PLATINUM, a metal. It has no issuer, no financial statements and no drivers — the campaign excludes metals by construction for exactly that reason — so it delivers no valuation study, there is no prose carrying figures and there is no numbers file to reconcile them against. This is not debt: there is nothing to build. It is listed rather than excluded silently because the population this gate anchors on is engine/*_study on disk [R-ENF-04], and XPT has a directory. The right fix is the gate's population, not a script for a metal; that is a gate amendment and is not done in passing.

note: Studies with no prose-figure verification when this gate was adopted (03-Sep-2026). Allowed to fail; the list may only ever get shorter. --prune rewrites it. Run --measure for the advisory unmatched rate per study.
